about: Environment switches that make an OLD library version announce what the target version breaks. Set them for the baseline capture so its recorded warnings predict the breaks.

entries.effect: SQLAlchemy 1.4 emits RemovedIn20Warning for every 1.x-style usage that 2.0 removes.
NumPy 1.24-1.26 warns wherever NEP 50 (the 2.0 promotion rules) would change a result dtype.
entries.source: NEP 50 and the NumPy 2.0 migration guide
